title: Data Breach Response Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request breach details from companies. Get clear answers about what data was exposed and what steps they're taking.
description: Use this formal letter template to request detailed information from companies about data breaches affecting your personal information. Includes specific questions to ask and your legal rights as a breach victim.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Email]
[Your Phone Number]

[Date]

[Company Name]
[Data Protection Officer/Security Team]
[Company Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening Statement
sections.content:
Subject: Data Breach Information Request - Account [Account Number/Username]

Dear Data Security Team,

I am writing to request detailed information regarding the data breach that occurred at [Company Name] on approximately [Breach Date]. As an affected customer, I am exercising my rights under applicable data protection laws to understand the scope and impact of this incident on my personal information.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
Please provide the following information about the data breach:

1. What specific types of personal information were accessed or stolen (names, addresses, Social Security numbers, payment information, etc.)?

2. What was the exact date and time frame of the breach?

3. How many individuals were affected by this breach?

4. How was the breach discovered and by whom?

5. What security measures were in place at the time of the breach?

6. Has law enforcement been notified, and have you filed reports with relevant regulatory authorities?

sections.heading: Remediation and Protection Measures
sections.content:
Additionally, please explain:

1. What immediate steps has [Company Name] taken to secure the compromised systems?

2. What long-term security improvements are being implemented to prevent future breaches?

3. Are you providing identity monitoring services to affected customers? If so, for how long?

4. Will you cover costs related to identity theft or fraudulent accounts opened as a result of this breach?

5. What specific steps do you recommend I take to protect myself from potential identity theft or fraud?

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Timeline
sections.content:
I understand that under state and federal data protection laws, I have the right to receive clear and timely information about data breaches affecting my personal information. Please provide this information within 30 days of receiving this request.

If you have already sent breach notification communications, please resend them to the address above, as I may not have received the original notifications.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
Please send your response in writing to the address listed above or via email to [Your Email Address]. If you need to verify my identity or account information, please contact me at [Your Phone Number].

I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and look forward to your detailed response.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]

useCases: Requesting detailed breach information from companies that notified you of a data incident
Following up when you suspect your data was breached but received inadequate information
Demanding transparency about security measures and remediation steps after a breach
Establishing a paper trail for potential legal action or insurance claims
Ensuring you receive entitled identity protection services from the breached company
